senses.gloss:
ind.
A preposition and prefix, implying
1 After.
2 Like, in same manner.
3 Under, inferior to.
4 Along, lengthwise.
5 With, together with.
6 In part of.
7 Severally, each, by each.
8 Near to.
9 In regard to.
10 To, out to, (calling.)
11 Orderly, methodical.
As अनुकर्त्तुं to act like; अनुगन्तुं to follow; अनुकमितुं to proceed in order; अनुशयितुं to repent, &c.; also, अनुरूपं according to the form; अनुविष्णु according to VIṢṆU; अनुगं गं upon or along the Ganges. See also the following words.
E.
अन् to live, and ज aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-क)
Lustful, libidinous.
E.
अनु, and क from कम to desire.

m. (-कः)
A former state of existence.
n. (-क)
1 Race, family.
2 Disposition, temperament.
E.
अनु, उच to associate, and क aff.

n. (-नं)
Discourse, conversation.
E.
अनु, and कथन speaking.

f. (-म्पा)
Tenderness, compassion.
E.
अनु before कपि to tremble, and affix अच्, and टाप्.

mfn. (-म्प्यः-म्प्या-म्प्यं)
1 Swift, expeditious.
2 Pitiable, worthy of tenderness or compassion.
E.
अनु before कपि to tremble, य aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Imitation, making or doing any thing like or in imitation of another, following an example.
2 Resemblance, similarity.
E.
अनु, and करण making.

n. (-र्म्म)
1 Imitation.
2 A subsequent rite or ceremony.
E.
अनु, and कर्म्मन् act.

m. (-र्षः)
1 The bottom of a carriage.
2 Invoking, summoning by incantation.
3 Attraction, drawing.
E.
अनु before कृष to drag or furrow, and घञ् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Invoking, summoning by incantations.
2 Attracting, attraction.
3 Including a subsequent in a preceding rule.
E.
अनु, and कृष to draw, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-र्षा)
The bottom of a carriage. See अनुकर्ष.

m. (-ल्पः)
1 An alternative, a substitute.
2 A secondary, subsidiary or succedaneous injunction; as, instead of Kuśa grass use Dūrbbā.
E.
अनु after, and कल्प a principal precept.

ind.
According to wish or inclination.
E.
अनु, and काम desire.

m. (-नः)
1 One who goes as he lists.
2 One who acts as he pleases.
E.
अनुकामं and ईन, for गामिन् who goes.

m. (-रः)
1 Imitation.
2 Resemblance.
E.
अनु like, and कृञ् to do, with अण् aff.

mfn. (-री-रणी-रि)
Imitating, an imitator.
E.
अनुकार, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Friendly, well disposed to, favourable or conformable to.
m. (-ल)
A faithful husband.
f. (-ला)
Croton polyandrum.
n. (-लं)
Favour, kindness.
E.
अनु, and कूल race, family.

f. (-ता)
Concord, good will, consent.
E.
अनुकूल, and ता affix; also with त्व, अनुकूलत्व.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Copied, imitated, made like or done in like manner.
E.
अनु, and कृत made.

mfn. (-चः-चा-चं)
Serrated, dentated.
E.
अनु like, क्रकत्र a saw.

m. (-मः)
Order, method.
E.
अनु methodically, and क्रम to go, with घञ् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Proceeding methodically or in order.
2 Following.
E.
अनु and कसण going.

f. (-का)
A table or chapter of contents.
E.
कन् fem. form added to the last.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Done methodically, passed over, read, &c. in due order.
E.
अनु, and क्रान्त gone.

f. (-या)
1 Imitation, doing any thing subsequently or in like manner.
2 A subsequent rite or ceremony.
E.
अनु, and क्रिया act.

m. (-शः)
Tenderness, compassion.
E.
अनु, क्रुश to bewail, घञ् aff.

n. adv. (-णं)
Momentarily, perpetually.
E.
अनु, and क्षण a moment.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
1 Following.
2 A follower, a servant.
m. (-गः)
A husband, a master.
E.
अनु after, and ग who goes.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Followed, literally or figuratively, as by a dependant, &c.
2 Following, a follower or a dependant.
3 Acquired, obtained.
4 Determined, defined.
E.
अन, and गत gone.

m. (मः)
1 Following, going after in life or death.
2 Imitating, approaching.
E.
अनु, and गम going.

n. (-नं)
1 Going after, following.
2 Dying after, as of a widow. See अनुमरण.
E.
अनु, and गमन going.

mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं)
Worthy of being followed or imitated.
E.
अनु, and गम्य to be gone.

m. (-नः)
A cowherd.
E.
अनु, and गवीन belonging to kine.

m. (-मी)
1 A companion, a follower.
2 One who goes behind or after.
E.
अनु after or with, and गामिन् who goes.

mfn. (-णः-णा-ण)
According or suitable to, according to merit or property.
E.
अनु, and गुण quality.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Favoured, obliged.
E.
अनु, and गृहीत^1 taken.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320.

mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं)
Calm, gentle, not violent.
E.
अन्, neg. उग्र fierce.

m. (-हः)
Favour; conferring benefits, promoting good, and preventing ill.
E.
अनु afterwards, ग्रह to take, and अच् aff.

mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि)
Gracious, favourable.
E.
अनु, and ग्राहिन् who takes.

m. (-रः)
1 A companion, a follower.
2 A servant.
f. (-री)
A female companion.
E.
अनु with or after, and चर to go, ट aff.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Following, attending.
E.
अनु before चारिन् who goes.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Improper, wrong.
E.
अन् neg. उचित proper.

f. (-न्ता)
Thinking of, meditating upon, recalling, recollecting.
E.
अनु subsequent, चिन्ता thought.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Recollected, recalled, thought of.
E.
अनु and चिन्तित thought.

mfn. (-च्चः-च्चा-च्चं)
Low, not high, humble.
E.
अन neg. उच्च high.

mfn. (च्चः-च्चा-च्चं)
Short, low.
E.
अन् neg. and ऊच्च tall, high.

mfn. (ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Pure, purified by austerity and devotion.
E.
अन् neg. and उच्छिष्ट rejected.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Born after, later, younger.
m. (-जः)
A younger brother.
f. (-जा)
A younger sister.
E.
अनु after, ज born.

mfn. (-न्मा-न्मा-न्म)
Younger, junior.
E.
अनु after, and जन्मन् birth.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
After-born, later, younger.
m. (-तः)
A younger brother.
f. (-ता)
A younger sister.
E.
अनु after, जात born.

mfn. (तः-ता-तं)
Undiminished, unimpaired, not left or lost.
E.
अन् neg. उज्झित left.

mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि)
1 Servant, dependant.
2 A companion, a follower.
E.
अनु after or with, and जीविन् who lives.

f. (-ज्ञा)
1 An order or command.
2 Assent.
E.
अनु according to, ज्ञा to know, and क्विप् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Ordered, directed, instructed.
2 Assented to, permitted, allowed.
3 Accepted.
4 Acknowledged, recognised.
E.
अनु, and ज्ञात known.

m. (-कः)
One who commands or enjoins.
E.
अनु, and ज्ञापक who makes known.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
1 Heated.
2 Filled with regret or repentance.
E.
अनु, and तप्त heated.

n. (-रं)
Fare, freight.
E.
अनु, and तर what crosses.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Chief, principal.
2 Best, excellent.
3 Unable to answer, silent.
4 Fixed, firm.
5 Low, inferior.
6 South, southern.
n. (-रं)
A reply which is incoherent or evasive, and is therefore held to be no answer.
E.
अन् neg. and उत्तर subsequent, &c.

m. (-र्षः)
1 Thirst.
2 Wish, desire.
3 A drinking vessel, one used to drink spirituous liquors from. See अनुतर्षण.
E.
अनु and तष, from तृष to thirst, and घञ् aff.

m. (-णं)
1 A vessel from which spirituous liquor is drunk.
2 Distributing liquor.
E.
अनु before तृष to be thirsty, and ल्युट् aff.

m. (-पः)
1 Repentance.
2 Heat.
E.
अनु afterwards, and ताप heat, pain.

mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि)
Penitent, regretting.
E.
अनुताप and इनि aff.

mfn. (-त्कः-त्का-त्कं)
Free from regret, possessed of self-complacency.
E.
अन् neg. उत्क sorry.

m. (-र्षः)
Inferiority.
E.
अन् neg. उत्कर्ष superiority.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Chief, principal, best.
2 Worse, inferior, not best.
E.
अन् neg. and उत्तम best.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Lying with the face to the ground.
E.
अन neg. उत्तान sleeping, supine.

f. (-त्तिः)
1 Failure.
2 Non-production.
E.
अन् neg. उत्पत्ति production.

mfn. (न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Uneffected, unaccomplished.
2 Unborn, unproduced.
E.
अन् neg. उत्पन्न produced.

mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं)
1 Very lofty.
2 Not lofty, low.
E.
अन्, neg. उदग्र lofty.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Thin, lank.
E.
अन् neg. उदर belly.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Liberal, munificent.
2 Niggardly, mean.
3 Adhered to or followed by a wife.
E.
अन् neg. उदार liberal, or अनु, and दार wife.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Unaccented.
m. (-त्तः)
One of the three accents to be observed in reading the Vedas, the grave accent.
E.
अन् neg. उत् high, and आत्त pronounced, from दा to give, with आङ prefixed, to speak, and क्त affixed: pronouncing the vowels in a low and full tone.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Unrisen.
2 Unsaid, unuttered.
E.
अन् neg. उदित risen or said.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unuttered.
E.
अन् before ऊदित said.

adv. n. (-नं)
Daily.
E.
अनु, and दिन day.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Unsurpassed, unequalled.
2 Unopposed.
3 Humble.
E.
अन् neg. उद्वत proud, &c.

m. (-ण)
1 Non-removal.
2 Not offering.
3 Not establishing or proving.
E.
अन् neg. उद्धरण taking away.

m. (-रः)
1 Non-partition, not taking a share.
2 Non-removal.
E.
अन् neg. उद्धार partition.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Non-removed, not taken away.
2 Uninjured, undestroyed.
3 Unoffered.
4 Undivided, unpartitioned.
5 Unestablished, unproved.
E.
अन् neg. उद्धृत removed.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Inactive, idle, destitute of perseverance.
E.
अन् neg. उद्यत active.

m. (-गः)
Absence of exertion or effort, laziness.
E.
अन् neg. उद्योग effort.

mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि)
Lazy, indifferent.
E.
अनुद्याम, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Followed, pursued.
n. (-तं)
A measure of time in music, half a Druta, or one-fourth of a Mātra or time taken to articulate a short vowel.
E.
अनु after, and द्रुत gone, escaped.

m. (-हः)
Celibacy.
E.
अन् neg. उद्वाह marriage.

mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं)
Easy, free from apprehension or perplexity.
E.
अन् neg. उद्विग्न anxious.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Free from anxiety.
m. (-गः)
Freedom from anxiety.
E.
अन् neg. उद्वेग anxiety.

n. (-तं)
1 Chasing, pursuit, running after.
2 Pursuit of any object, as of a mistress, &c.
E.
अनु, and धावन running.

mfn. (-तः-ता-त)
Pursued, run after, literally or figuratively.
E.
अनु, and धावित run.

m. (-यः)
1 Salutation, courtesy, civility, shewing respect or adoration to a guest or a deity.
2 Regulation of conduct, discipline, tuition.
E.
अनु^1 and नय, from णीञ्^2 to guide or lead, and अच् aff.
[1] Correction submitted by SergeA on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batche 313.
[2] Correction submitted by SergeA on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batche 313.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Courteous, humble.
E.
अनुनय, and इनि aff.

m. (-दः)
Sound, consequent sound, vibration, echo.
E.
अनु, and नाद noise.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Nasal, uttered through the nose.
E.
अनु and नासिका the nose.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Trained, disciplined.
2 Obtained, acquired.
3 Taught.
4 Respected.
5 Pleased, pacified, appeased.
E.
अनु, and नीत brought.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Sane, sober, not wild, not mad: so अनुन्माद.
E.
अन् neg. उन्मत्त mad.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Watery, marshy; more usually अनूप.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Watery, wet.
m. (-पः)
A buffalo.
E.
अनु near or with, and आप् water; ऊ is substituted for आ, and अच् is added.

m. (-पः)
Any animal frequenting marshy places, as a buffalo, &c.
E.
अनूप marshy ground, and अण् aff.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Not assisting, neglecting, ungrateful.
E.
अन् neg. उपकारित assisting.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unassisted.
E.
अन् neg. उपकृत assisted.

n. (-नं)
1 Falling on or upon.
2 Following.
E.
अनु, and पतन falling, &c.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Fallen, descended.
2 Followed.
E.
अनु, and पतित fallen.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Untaught, uninstructed.
E.
अन् neg. उपदिष्ट advised.

ind.
1 Following.
2 Step by step.
3 Upon the foot.
n. (-दं)
A burthen, a word or passage repeated.
E.
अनु, and पद a foot.

m. (-दी)
A searcher, an inquirer, one who follows or seeks for.
E.
अनुपदम् following, and इनि aff.

f. (-ना)
A boot, a buskin.
E.
अनुपद upon the foot, and ख aff.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
Undetermined, not established.
E.
अन् neg. उपन्यस्त fixed.

m. (-सः)
Failure of proof or determination, uncertainty, doubt.
E.
अन् neg. उपन्यास ascertainment.

f. (-त्तिः)
1 Not supporting an assertion by good argument, inconclusive argumentation.
2 Non-completion, not effecting or accomplishing, failure.
E.
अन् neg. उपपत्ति demonstration.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Not done, unaccomplished, uneffected.
2 Unproved, undemonstrated.
E.
अन् neg. उपपन्न effected.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Following, conforming to.
E.
अनु, and प्रपन्न done.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Unenjoyed, unpossessed.
E.
अन् neg. उपभुक्त enjoyed.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Excellent, best.
f. (-मा)
The female elephant of the south-east, or of the north-east.
E.
अन् neg. and उपमा resemblance; above comparison.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Incomparable: so अनुपमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं).
E.
अन् neg. उपमित compared, or उपमेय comparable.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Useless, unnecessary, unserviceable.
E.
अन् neg. उपयुक्त serviceable.

m. (-गः)
Unserviceableness, uselessness.
E.
अन् neg. उपयोग utility.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unmarked, undiscriminated.
E.
अन् neg. उपलक्षित marked.

mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं)
1 Unperceived, unascertained.
2 Unobtained.
E.
अन् neg. उपलब्ध obtained.

m. (-यः)
Any aggravating thing or circumstance, (in medicine) what increases the disease.
E.
अन् neg. उपशय a palliative.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Undressed, unprepared.
2 Unfinished, unpolished.
3 Unrequited.
E.
अन् neg. उपस्कृत finished.

n. (-नं)
Absence.
E.
अन् neg. उपस्थान vicinity.

n. (-नं)
Not producing, not offering, not placing, not having ready or at hand.
E.
अन् neg. उप near, स्थापन placing.

mfn. (-तः-ता-त)
Not ready, not at hand, not offered or produced.
E.
अन् neg. उपस्थापित placed near.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Absent, distant.
E.
अन् neg. उपस्थायिन् near.

f. (-तिः)
Absence.
E.
अन् neg. उपस्थिति vicinity.

m. (-तः)
1 Falling subsequently upon, alighting or descending upon in succession.
2 Going, proceeding.
3 Following.
4 A degree of latitude opposite to one given, the antoeci.
5 Proportion, (in arithmetic.)
6 Arithmetical progression.
E.
अनु, and पात falling, &c.

n. (-कं)
A heinous crime, as, falsehood, fraud, theft, adultery, &c.
E.
अनु, and पातक crime.

n. (-नं)
A fluid vehicle in medicine; drink taken with or after medicine.
E.
अनु after or with, and पान a drink.

mfn. (-र्श्वः-र्श्वा-र्श्वं)
Lateral.
E.
अनु by or upon, पार्श्व the side.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Obtained, attained, arrived at.
E.
अनु, and प्राप्त obtained.

m. (-ष्पः)
A kind of reed, (Saccharum sara.)
E.
अनु before पुष्प to put forth flowers, and अच् aff.

mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं)
Regular, orderly, successively, from the preceding.
E.
अनु after, पूर्व्व prior.

nf. (-र्व्वं-र्व्वी)
1 Order, series, succession.
2 (In law) Direct order of the castes. (In logic) A conclusion, regularly or syllogistically deduced.
E.
अनु subsequent, पूर्व्व first, अण् affix; also आनुपूर्व्व्य and आनुपूर्व्वक.

ind.
In regular order or succession, from the first, from above downwards.
E.
अनुपूर्व्व and शसि aff.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Unsown, (as seed.)
E.
अन् neg. उप्त sown.

mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं)
Fallow, meadow, (ground, &c.)
E.
अन् neg. उप्त sown, शस्य grain.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Latitudinal.
E.
अनु neg. according to, प्रस्थ extending.

m. (-सः)
Alliteration, repetition of similar letters, syllables and words.
E.
अनु and प्र before अस् to be, affix चञ्.

m. (-वः)
A companion or follower.
E.
अनु, प्लु to go, and अप् aff.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
Bound to, connected with.
E.
अनु, and बद्ध bound.

m. (-न्धः)
1 The inseparable adjunct or sign of any thing, the indication of guilt, symptom of disease, &c.
2 An element of language, root, affix, &c.
